preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 50,000.
Each test case must have N elements in arrays A and B, where N is between 2 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 100000 for i in range(N)) and all(1 <= B[i] <= 100000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in arrays A and B must be between 1 and 100,000.
The total number of elements across all test cases must not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of points Chef can get while converting array A into array B.
